AI chatbot Claude adds workplace productivity tools to challenge Microsoft, Google

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has updated its Claude chatbot with new tools designed to enhance workplace productivity. The updates include AI-powered spreadsheets, digital whiteboards, and data dashboards. These new features aim to compete with offerings from Microsoft and Google. Anthropic has also integrated Claude with other business software platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce, and Atlassian. The company is reportedly preparing for an initial public offering (IPO).
